However, her talent for magic is abnormal, and a prince, along with many other noble young men have either become infatuated with her, aim to kill her, or almost die… that isn’t “moderate” at all! But even so, she swears to obtain the happy life she envisioned, somehow!

1153.synopsis:

This restaurant looks completely normal through the week, but on Saturday’s, it opens in secret exclusively to some very unique guests. During these hours, doors in various areas of a parallel world open to allow customers of many different races and cultures into the restaurant.
This “Restaurant to Another World”, and its food, holds an exotic charm to these highly diverse customers.
This is a story of the heartwarming, once-in-a-lifetime encounters between our reality and another world, between the restaurant’s customers and its owner, and the food shared among them all.

Although she serves the Marquess of Jing-An as a maid, she leads a life far richer than most women. Her plain appearance is not what defines her — but her intelligence, far beyond many wise men. 
Although Chu Beijie was an enemy general, she still cannot help being attracted to this man, despite the many lies and conspiracies…but between love and loyalty, she must make a choice. She can only hope that man’s love for her isn’t as deep as she thought.
One is a soul who seemingly destroys peace while the other aspires to be the sword that saves. Between them, lies a mountain of hate…

Ever since he was picked up by the sect leader two years ago, he has no memories of his earlier life except a recurring nightmare. Navigating the rigid class structure and intricacies of the cultivation world, as one of the lowest possible of the lowest class, Zuo Mo’s dream is to earn money, and lots of it, through being a spiritual plant farmer. A chance occurrence reveals that someone powerful had changed Zuo’s features and erased his mind. The money grubbing zombie decides to set out on a journey of cultivation to find out answers. Fate colludes with chance, the drums of war are beating, the ghost of his past is coming…

8833.synopsis:
“A 30 year old man awaken, 300 years later, in the body of the 16 year old sick girl. For both he and she to survive, they must play the super hardcore online game together, along with their different age and gender. Will they pass?”
—
In this world, there’s less than 1% of human who know this one inconvenient truth :  the reality of the world we hear, see, and perceive is the infinitesimal fragment of the reality. 
Truth : Through the delusion of one’s perception, human never know that they are moving across the space at the speed over 220 Km __per second__ !!!
Truth : Over 99.99999999% of your body is space, blank, and nothingness !!!!
Truth : Your self is not yours. Over 90% of the cells in your body are the other creatures’ DNA !!! Your body will have the new cells replenished every moment. You of this body, at this very second,  is NOT you ten years before. 
Except for the brain cells, all parts of your body are replaced every day. Could it be that The Human are just a bunch of brain cells?
Color is something some animals can’t see, it’s just non-existed for them.
Within the same perspective, can we say with full confident that our world is nothing except things we perceive through our senses? 
If that’s so, what is the difference between the virtual world and the real world, if it is just the illusion that occurs in our brain?
What is the difference between three hundred years of the sleep and dreaming of nothingness, and the one night of the sleepless in the fantastic virtual world of the game?

associated_names: 与穿来的将军丈夫在边疆养娃[七零]

97409.synopsis:
Grace Gurton has been harboring a one-sided love for months.
The object of her affection is Richard Spencer, the Young Earl of Spencer.
Heir to the Spencer family, an aristocracy older than the royal family itself and standing at the king’s side, and Captain of the Rugby Club at Christ Church College.
The embodiment of refined, aristocratic elegance. Impeccably perfect attire.
A masculine and handsome face, combined with a towering height that stands out anywhere.
A rugged and god-like ferocity on display during rugby matches, as though the god of war himself has descended.
From afar, Richard Spencer appeared flawless.
At least, until Grace received an adoption proposal from Lady Mary Montague, Richard’s aunt.
And until she discovered the reality of Richard Spencer, a self-centered narcissist who seems to live as though the world revolves around him.

101505.synopsis:
I accidentally started working at the academy’s alchemy shop.
But the magic tools I make,
They’re selling well… too well.

101761.synopsis:
“Kristin Hilton said she summoned the devil using a live chicken as a sacrifice.”
Branded a devil worshiper, a freak, and a psycho, Kristin is shunned by everyone. But behind her dark reputation lies a shocking truth: she has realized she is merely a supporting extra in a B-grade horror movie, destined to be brutally slaughtered.
Determined to rewrite her tragic fate, she attempts to flee before reaching the cursed campsite.
Just as she makes her move—
[You will now enter the Horror Dungeon Gate.] 
A system window pops up out of nowhere, awakening her as a ‘Necromancer’!
‘What the hell? Wasn’t this just an ordinary horror movie?!’
While navigating the deadly dungeon, Kristin attempts to resurrect Alec Raimi—the popular captain of the football team who died trying to save her. But instead of an ordinary corpse, her necromancy accidentally summons a dangerous, transcendent being straight from hell into his body.
To make matters worse, the system forces a bizarre restriction on him:
[The summon is automatically constrained to output ‘Master’ whenever calling the summoner by a different name.] 
“Master! …Owner?”
Hearing Alec call her ‘Master’, her friends’ expressions turn intensely suspicious, throwing Kristin into an absurd, scandalous misunderstanding.
“Hey, Master. You said you shouldn’t be separated from me.”
With hellish energy coursing through him and his eyes gleaming dangerously, the resurrected athlete begins to form a dark, seductive obsession with the girl who brought him back.
associated_names: I Was Transmigrated into a B-Grade Horror Movie, but It’s Rated 19+?

102785.synopsis: After being discharged from military service, dreaming of a comfortable life, the protagonist gets a job at an academy. However, too many incidents keep occurring at the academy.
associated_names: The Academy's School Nurse Wants to Rest (Novelpia Global)

103809.synopsis:
Yu Pei: Understood!
Su Zhan is brutal, twisted, and bloodthirsty, regarded as a monster by the world. For over a decade, countless cultivators from all realms have united to hunt him down, but they could not completely eliminate him and could only temporarily seal his heart. 
After enduring numerous hardships, Yu Pei finally found the monster’s heart on the Demon Mountain—  
a fluffy ball.  
Yu Pei: ?  
The system alerted, “Host, don’t be deceived by its cute appearance, it’s actually sinister and vicious, very terrifying! Take your time to conquer it, we have plenty of time.”  
Just after saying that, the fluffy creature eagerly rolled into Yu Pei’s arms, and a suspicious red hue peeked through its dark fur.  
Fluffy Ball: Gurgle, gurgle o(*≧+3≦)o  
System: ?! Where did this dog come from?  
Yu Pei: Damn! Where’s the sinister? Where’s the vicious? Where’s the sack?  
After finally getting the heart away from the Demon Mountain, Yu Pei was stopped midway by the bamboo horse, Zhu Yu.  
Zhu Yu said with concern, “You broke up with me and ran away from home, is it to seek another love?”  
Before Yu Pei could respond, her peripheral vision caught a glimpse of his robe, where tent**les were carelessly hidden—just like the ones on that fluffy creature.  
Yu, *Eyes Quaking*, Pei: Oh no! It seems I’ve discovered a shocking secret.
“Is it the young master of the ghost domain guarding the mountain, the half-demon beside you, or your new sect brother?”  
The young man appeared calm, but his golden eyes revealed a strange and fierce aura.  
In the dim light, vine-like mist began to coil around Yu Pei’s waist. He chuckled softly, brushing against her nape, his breath scorching.  
“Tell me, aside from your brother, who else does Peipei want?”  
“Don’t worry, I won’t touch him.”  
Yu Pei: …Then can you at least put down the sword in your hand?

104577.synopsis: Lu Zheng was abandoned by his family and had to go to the countryside. On the first day of going to the countryside, a little girl rolled into his arms and into his heart. Unfortunately, the little girl had a fiancé, and the fiancé liked the little girl very much. There was no choice but to rob her… If you don’t work for yourself, you will be punished by heaven and earth. In order to marry a wife, it’s not shabby! The little locust tree became a little fool and learned to live like a human in this village with difficulty. She knew she had a fiancé, but when did this fiancé change? The good-looking brother who gave her candy every day actually hugged her and coaxed her every day… The timid little locust tree was so happy! There were delicious food, good drinks, beautiful clothes… and nice things to touch…
associated_names: 娇宠七零，抢来的媳妇贼香

105345.synopsis:
Six years had passed since Hazel Langbelle Easton entered the aristocratic society.
She was known as the sole spinster of the Easton family, for she viewed marriage as nothing but a tomb for a woman.
Hazel had always been confident that no man in this world could make her heart beat with passion.
Yet someone once said:
[God is exceedingly cunning; He does not favor humans who assert with absolute certainty that something could never happen. Thus, the moment a person declares with conviction that a thing is impossible, events take an unexpected turn, leading precisely to the occurrence of that very thing.] 
***
Hazel placed her hand on her forehead, gazing at the handsome man seated before her.
A woman indifferent to marriage, an outcast in aristocratic society, often pointed at as a black raven, a harbinger of ill fortune.
In contrast, Theodore Caron Bernier, the most renowned bachelor and the finest suitor in the entire kingdom.
Never had Hazel imagined that he might ask for her hand in marriage…
“Would you do me the honor of marrying me, Miss Hazel?”
Thump. Thump.
Hazel’s heart pounded fiercely.
With a single, simple phrase, Theodore had managed to make her heart tremble.
She parted her lips slightly, clutching her chest as her heartbeat quickened from the sheer shock.
How could Duke Theodore possibly ask for her hand in marriage?
It was nothing short of a shock to her.
But it was not, by any means, a joyful shock.

106625.synopsis:
“Hero, where are you going?”  
“To eat.”  
“Hero, where are you going?”  
“To the bathroom.”  
“Hero…!”  
“…”  
The woman who followed me everywhere… Ended up following me all the way to Earth.  
———
A former hero who returned to Earth, now unemployed and just lazing around at home.  
Then, the saintess who came with him made a suggestion—  
“How about streaming?”  
“Hmm… This might actually be a good idea.”  
And so, the Hero & Saintess Healing Stream begins!

106881.synopsis:
Mi Zhao unexpectedly caught his boyfriend, Li Yan, cheating. While out for a walk to clear his mind, he met a man who shared his pain.
The man had a disability, sitting in a wheelchair, and was a kept man until he was recently abandoned.
Mi Zhao looked at the man—his features were sharp, with deep-set eyes, a perfectly handsome appearance, but his aura was somewhat gloomy.
One day, after drinking, he asked the man, “Would you want to change your way of life?”
The man’s face flushed red, and he stammered, “What kind of way?”
From that day on, in order to give the man a better life, Mi Zhao worked even harder at part-time jobs, until one day, during a date, he was intercepted by Li Yan.
Li Yan angrily said, “I knew it! You must have another man, that’s why you’re eager to dump me. I heard you’re supporting him? I’ll see what kind of man he is!”
Li Yan rushed into the private room, took one look, and immediately stumbled. “U-uncle?!”
•
The Li family was a prestigious name in A City, known for its many branches and sons and daughters. However, few knew that the most influential person in the Li family was the rarely seen Third Master.
When Third Master coughed, the entire Li family would tremble.
But somehow, people began to notice a change in the usually indifferent and uninterested Third Master. He started using his phone frequently and went out often.
Could it be that Third Master was in love?
The news reached the ears of the old madam of the Li family, who quickly arranged for an assistant to investigate.
Third Master didn’t hide anything and openly said he had a boyfriend who was still a student. His boyfriend was very affectionate, often giving him gifts, which left him troubled. He was afraid that rejecting his boyfriend might hurt his feelings, while also worrying about his boyfriend’s financial situation.
The assistant, sweating, suggested, “If he likes buying things so much, why don’t you give him a black card?”
That day, Mi Zhao held the black card in silence for a long time, then asked, “Are you going to end our relationship?”
Third Master: “?”
He belatedly realized that his boyfriend seemed to have misunderstood something.

107393.synopsis:
I, Wang Luowei, somehow ended up transmigrating into the “wholesome, uplifting” world of Honkai Impact 3rd—only to become my most hated character, the Herrscher of Corruption!
Well, whatever. Since I’m here, might as own it. 
“Hey folks, let’s turn our gaze to the horizon—” 
Wait, hold up. 
Where the hell am I? Siberia, 2000?!
associated_names: Honkai Impact: Oh No, I've Become an Erosion Herrscher?
崩坏：坏了，我成侵蚀律者了？

109185.synopsis:
The Heresy Inquisitors – a special task force of the Pantheon Temple who handle the dirtiest work in the lowest, darkest places.
For the sake of tasks that someone had to do, I had to make sacrifices, and now I’ve been given a second chance I never wanted.
“Though today may be like this, won’t ‘tomorrow’ be better?”
“Yes. I’ll do better.”
The world ended.
But from now on, only the world I remember will have ended.
At this moment, what I must do from ‘tomorrow’ onward has been decided.
associated_names: The Devil Hunting Method of the Returning Inquisitor

110977.synopsis:
【Little Toddler】【Space】【Farming】【Warm-hearted】
After five generations of only sons, the old Su family finally had a baby — and it was a girl!
But they were fleeing from famine.
The Su family members said,
“This is the first girl born into our family! Even if we starve to death ourselves, we mustn’t let Little Fifth starve!”
As soon as the words fell, a plump hen suddenly flew out from the direction Little Fifth pointed her tiny hand at.
When the Su men went out hunting, and were about to return empty-handed, Little Fifth clapped her little hands — and not only did they encounter a sheep, they even picked up a whole nest of eggs for free.
When the eldest and second brothers went to wash their hands, Little Fifth giggled, and strangely enough, the ditch became crowded with fish!
Incidents like these gradually became more frequent.
The Su family slowly realized: Unbelievable! Their Little Fifth was a little bringer of fortune!
When they went to the capital to seek refuge with relatives, the relatives took one look at their shabby clothes, swindled them out of money, refused to take them in, and secretly sold them an abandoned house at a high price.
This abandoned house had a history of death — whoever moved in was said to suffer misfortune.
Yet somehow, not only did the Su family remain safe, they even repaired the house, raised chickens, ducks, cattle, and sheep, harvested a bumper crop of vegetables and grains, and even produced a young scholar from the family!
What was going on?
How did a haunted house turn into a prosperous home?
Meanwhile, the nation’s fortune had been stolen. The emperor grew increasingly anxious.
The Grand Priest said,
“Your Majesty, I have a plan. If we marry the little girl from the Su family into the royal family, perhaps it could bring blessings to the whole nation…”
The emperor said,
“…Do you think I don’t want to? They said their family has an inheritance to pass down, and they aren’t interested in us!”

114817.synopsis:
It has been three years since he transmigrated into the body of a doomed villain in a regret-filled novel.
‘Ersen Mayer’ tried desperately hard to be loved, and in the process, managed to drag every character’s life straight into the mud.
Only when he was brutally tortured and killed by the person he trusted most did Ersen finally realize the truth that no matter what he did, love would never come to him.
And then, he gets a second chance.
‘This time, I’ll really do it right. I won’t ruin anything.’
Thrilled by the opportunity to live again, Ersen resolves to play the villain cleanly, finish the tasks he must, and then die quietly without asking anything of anyone. But…
“Are you out of your mind? You drank poison again.”
“For the next mission, I’m coming with you. Whatever you’re doing, don’t do it alone.”
“It’s time for your soup! I brought your medicine too.”
…Why is everyone acting strangely?
* * *
“How’s your body?”
“I’m fine.”
“What part of that is fine? I heard you barged straight into a half-demon hideout, broke the barrier, and even used some strange power?”
“Come on, that’s nothing to be so shocked about.”
The prince’s face went pale as he spoke, waving his hand in that annoyingly flippant way.
“It’s exactly because it isn’t ‘nothing’ that it’s a problem.”
“Don’t worry. I told you, I don’t break easily.”
Theodore let out a sigh. His fingertips tapped at the empty air before coming to a stop.
“Take it easy. If you keep pushing yourself like this… you’re only going to regret it later.”
Ersen closed his eyes.
And he whispered words no one could hear.
‘I know. I know that better than anyone.’
Regret was already something he had far too much of.

119937.synopsis:
【Global data synchronization complete】
【Welcome to 100 Days of Chaos】
…
【Zombie Level Classification: E (Normal), D (Enhanced), C (Elite), B (Mutant), A (Lord), S (King), SS (Catastrophe), SSS (Apocalypse)】
【Zombies evolve daily, increasing in both quantity and quality】
【Every tenth day is a Blood Moon Night. Players cannot sleep, and zombies receive additional enhancements】
Chen Yang awakens the Eternal Talent and starts with an infinite ammo turret.
Ordinary villagers, empowered by the Eternal Talent, transform into nuclear-powered survivors!
As hundreds of turrets surround Chen Yang—
Just as he starts to feel completely safe, billions of zombies come charging in…
associated_names: 亿万僵尸来袭，开局无限子弹炮台

122497.synopsis:
Shen Ji transmigrated into the most terrifying pollutant in a post-apocalyptic novel.
As the first pollutant to retain rationality, he was cunning, paranoid, and insane, relentlessly eroding humanity’s living space. Finally pushed to the brink, humans dispatched a special operations team to storm his territory and eliminate him.
Faced with imminent annihilation, Shen Ji quickly faked his death, donned a human disguise, and blended into society to live out his days in obscurity—only to accidentally become a revered master of contaminated disease treatment that was adored by thousands.
Rumors claimed he was a special doctor trained by a secret department and hid his identity to practice medicine.
But his disguise was so poor that people could only pretend not to notice to preserve the little doctor’s dignity.
Shen Ji: ??
That’s not true! Stop spreading lies!

125569.synopsis:
I had never played a game in my life.
But at the request of my older brother, I ended up starting Korea’s most popular game, The Legendary Sword.
[Party] HandsomeWithMask: Let’s move already;;
[General] Sunnyah: Me?
[Party] HandsomeWithMask: So what, the DPS goes first? You’re the tank, so take the lead, please.
My brother explicitly told me not to choose the tank role because it’s too hard for beginners…
And yet, cluelessly, I somehow picked the exact role he warned me against — the Tank.Just when I was about to quit the game altogether,
the top-ranked healer in The Legendary Sword, Hwanseong, appeared.
[Party] Hwanseong: Sunnyah, I’m your healer and I’m the one taking care of you anyway, so just relax and let’s go.
Thanks to his angelic support, I was able to clear the dungeon without a hitch,
and that connection even led to me joining the guild he belongs to.But now, the star healer keeps sticking to me like glue —
our nicknames are always popping up on the game community forums,
and all I wanted was to quietly play the game…
But somehow, I ended up becoming a famous user.“Yoon-hye.”
“…Yes?” Wait, why does it feel like this guy knows me?

126337.synopsis:
The Nine Provinces Continent is a dog-eat-dog world where the law of the jungle reigns and self-interest is paramount.
As an outer sect disciple of the Zhengyang Sect in Qing Province, Rong Su has always been crystal clear about her goals: cultivate, become stronger, and kill anyone who stands in her way. If anyone defies her, she’ll meet them with her blade.
Then, she encounters a small ball of light claiming to be the Heavenly Dao, which tells her she is destined to die.
After that, during the outer sect’s grand competition, she accidentally sleeps with the eldest young lady from Qing Province’s most prominent clan—a woman who is rumored to be a major villain. And so, her life is turned completely upside down.
Before meeting Nangong Yan, Rong Su thought her life was set on a single, bleak path.
After meeting Nangong Yan, she learns that the path of cultivation is not only for revenge. The same blade used for slaughter can also part the clouds and cleave the mists, all just to see the person standing behind them.

127361.synopsis: Zenjiro Iwanaga, 27 years old, is suddenly abducted and summoned to another world. This world is one with occupations and skills. Three high school girls summoned along with Zenjiro were granted quite good occupations and skills upon their summoning, but for some reason, Zenjiro received nothing. As a result, he is deemed useless by those who summoned him and is imprisoned. Although Zenjiro had no occupation or skills, he actually possessed a large amount of skill points. Using the skills he acquired with these skill points, Zenjiro escapes from his summoners, and while subtly getting back at those who abducted and summoned him using his convenient skills, he freely enjoys a comfortable life by bringing modern items into the other world. Please note that this story is a work of fiction. Existing laws and regulations may not necessarily apply within the work. Furthermore, the characters, organizations, names, and country names that appear are fictional and have no relation whatsoever to any real-world entities.
associated_names: 岩永善次郎、異世界と現代日本を行き来する

131969.synopsis:
Wen Ying is an unloved princess. Her mother died young, and she was banished to a remote, frigid palace where she survived on stale buns. Her clothes were cast-offs even the palace maids rejected, which she clumsily patched and stitched herself. For fifteen years, she endured hunger, cold, and neglect.
Then came the hostage prince , a symbol of her nation’s surrender to its enemy. Curious, Wen Ying climbed the palace wall and peeked over,  only to see a breathtaking beauty. Stunned by her appearance, Wen Ying pointed pitifully at the pastries in her hands and asked, “Big sister, may I have a bite?”
That day, the beauty collapsed in Wen Ying’s courtyard, tears streaming from pain. Terrified, Wen Ying offered her treasured dried persimmon, gently poking her cheek: “Big sister, I’ll share half with you. Please don’t cry.”
The beauty wiped the blood from her lips and fled in panic  but returned the next day, bearing fresh wounds and a tray of pastries to share. Wen Ying was overjoyed until one night, the beauty’s lips brushed her fingertips. “I… I’ll pay you back for the pastries when I have money!” Wen Ying sobbed, thinking she was being sold off.
But the beauty only held her tighter, voice husky as she l**ked away Wen Ying’s tears: “Your tears, Princess, are my payment.”
Flashback: Before the Fall
On the eve of her kingdom’s collapse, Fu Qingyin was sent to the enemy nation by her mother. Ashamed and furious, she nearly took her own life  until a small head popped up over the wall. She thought Wen Ying was the enemy’s daughter and kept her distance.
But when Wen Ying cried and offered her persimmon, saying, “You’re the only one who’s ever been kind to Wen Wen. Please get better soon…” Fu Qingyin realized the girl had suffered years of ab*se and had no bond with her tyrant father.
So she waited, endured, and rose from discarded hostage to Empress. Her heart, darkened by the world, held only one light: Wen Ying.
On the night of her coronation, Fu Qingyin embraced Wen Ying and confessed her love. She expected fear but instead, Wen Ying kissed her back.
One-line Summary: Mutual redemption, she was her only clarity.
Theme: Through hardship and adversity, they find success and healing.
associated_names: 釣系美人決定搶走公主
钓系美人决定抢走公主
钓系美人决定抢走公主

140673.synopsis:
In a Pilates class I reluctantly signed up for, I met a male instructor.
Even with a black mask covering his face, his sharp nose and well-toned body stood out.
During his intense and merciless classes, his touch, voice, and gaze made my entire body heat up.
“Imagine opening up your perineum. Lower your chest to the floor.”
With the 1-on-1 session I was lucky enough to receive, I started wishing his hands would reach deeper inside. His usual instructions began to sound oddly suggestive.
“Relax and stay comfortable. You don’t need to hold back any sounds.”
Don’t hold back any sounds?
Am I allowed to interpret that suggestively?
Unable to resist anymore, I finally blurted out a tempting request.
“Instructor, could you put it inside there too? With oil, please.”

141441.synopsis:
A [System] descends upon Earth, granting everyone a [Class] and an initial weapon, turning them into players. Players can level up and grow stronger by slaying monsters—but if they die, it’s true death.
Starting off as a Lancer, Bai Qiu has abnormally low Luck—poor drop rates, terrible fortune.
Yet, being in the prime of his youth, with unyielding determination and exceptional talent, he overcomes countless challenges and walks the path of an invincible great hero!
associated_names: 全民：抽取职阶，我成为了枪兵！

144257.synopsis:
In her past life, Song Yaoyao was an orphan. After completing a combined bachelor’s-master’s-doctoral program, she became a military surgeon. She died young from overwork during surgery and was reborn, transmigrating as a fetus into a fictional dynasty: the Tianfeng Nation.
In this life, Song Yaoyao’s father is a Senior Fourth-Rank Vice Minister of the Ministry of Revenue, and her mother is the legitimate daughter of a Second-Rank General. Doted on by her parents and older siblings, and blessed with such a wonderful family and status, she decides to live a life of utter indolence! Song Yaoyao’s motto for this life is simple: “Seize the day and drink the wine; let tomorrow’s sorrows be for tomorrow!”
The moment Song Yaoyao was born, she was bound to a “Gossip System.”
What Song Yaoyao doesn’t know yet is that from the moment she was born, her parents and older siblings can hear her inner voice
associated_names: 心声被偷听，满朝文武齐吃瓜

151169.synopsis:
“It’s just a job of catering to a child’s whims.”
The fall of his household, his parents’ deaths, his older sister’s accident.
Given the situation Euiju was in, something like exclusively caring for a child actor was nothing at all.
“Are you angry enough at me to act this dangerously? Jin Haeseong-ssi almost got hurt too.”
“You hate me. Since you hate me, I have to give you a reason.”
Unlike his angelic face and public image, Haeseong was prickly and violent, but—
“Tsk. Raising your hand against an adult.”
Euiju comes to see the figure of a wounded child within Haeseong’s wickedness, and Haeseong also begins to increasingly rely on Euiju, thinking of him as the only trustworthy adult. To the point where that reliance turns into obsession.
“I can’t do without ahjussi anymore. You said I became precious to you, right? Stay by my side forever.”
“As long as circumstances allow, I’ll continue to be by your side, so you don’t have to be too anxious, Haeseong-ah.”
However, a moment approaches when Euiju must choose between Haeseong and his family, and he ultimately chooses his family.
In the end, Haeseong misunderstands that Euiju abandoned him.
“Ahjussi, I’ve really been patient for so long. Stop disappointing me.”
And then, five years after parting like that, Euiju and Haeseong reunite…

163457.synopsis:
Gu Chen had been a s*umbag man in every lifetime. Whether male or female, everyone had been toyed with in the palm of his hand. In the end, he committed too many sins and couldn’t reincarnate, so he was forcibly dragged away to atone for them.
This time, I’ll be the nation’s ideal good man.
Don’t be afraid—I’m here!
associated_names: A Thousand Ways to Reform a Scumbag Man [Quick Transmigration]
渣男改造的千百种姿势[快穿]

165761.synopsis:
The cutest girl in the whole class… is you, sitting right next to me!
My name is Nakayama Tooru.
The girl sitting in the seat beside mine is my ridiculously cute classmate, Tanaka Sumika.
This world is supposed to be based on a rom-com manga, so Tanaka-san should just be a plain background mob character…
But she’s way cuter than the actual main heroine!?
She has this gentle, fluffy aura that makes her the perfect embodiment of my ideal girl. She’s a little clumsy too — she’ll accidentally bonk her head on things — but when she quietly leans over during class to whisper the answers I don’t get, and smiles at me… that smile is straight-up angelic.
Tanaka-san always says stuff like, “I’m pretty plain, you know~”
…but I’ll keep saying it until the day I die:
“No matter how you look at it, Tanaka-san is the cutest girl in the entire world…!?”
associated_names: メインヒロインより可愛いモブの田中さん

185473.synopsis:
Yang Moeun is a developer whose favorite hobby is quietly collecting data on her alpha CEO.
The decibel level of his voice, the brands of his suits, the name of his cologne, even his smallest, most meaningless habits. Day by day, her files on Kang Rowan grow more meticulous, more detailed. Until one day, he stumbles across her stalking little operation and offers her a deal dripping with arrogance.
“If you want it that badly, I’ll grant your wish. How often do I need to see you for you to be satisfied?”
But the answer he gets is not the one he expected.
“With all due respect… romantically, you don’t really have much appeal….”
His pride in pieces, Kang Rowan sets out from that day on to wield every ounce of charm he has and seduce Yang Moeun by any means necessary.
After plenty of twists and turns, he succeeds in winning her over physically. But a geek who loses interest can turn ice cold in an instant.
“If you want my attention, show me a new side of yourself. A service that stops updating doesn’t need maintenance either.”
And so, a man who had never been rejected in his life ends up clinging to her, practically begging to be stalked again….
A gloomy yet sweet office romance between a data-hoarding nerd of a developer and a CEO who lives purely to feed his own arrogance.

193665.synopsis:
Li Yaqin transmigrated into a 1960s fantasy novel, but unfortunately, she wasn’t the female lead; instead, she was the female lead’s invisible fifth sister.
The day after he transmigrated, he burned the female protagonist’s letter, which contained information about her seducing the village chief’s daughter’s fiancé.
Since she wants her fifth sister to stay in Lijia Village for the rest of her life, then she shouldn’t leave.
After burning the letter, Li Yaqin took advantage of serving her second sister-in- law to pick up a tough guy in the army camp. After a night of passion, Li Yaqin, who had taken a fertility pill, did not hesitate to give the man beside her a pill that would prevent her from having children.
This was her first step towards becoming someone of high status.
A woman with no special abilities can only rely on herself and the ability to scheme against herself to achieve her goals.
A woman who isn’t ruthless won’t have a stable position.
After marriage, can you really relax and have nothing to worry about?
That’s wishful thinking; that’s just the beginning.
What Li Yaqin wants is a child, a house, money, and a car.
Who isn’t selfish? Only a fool wouldn’t be selfish, and she clearly isn’t.
You provoked me, and you think you can just walk away? No way!
know your scheme perfectly well; your success is simply due to my leniency!
Otherwise, do you think scions of wealthy and powerful families are all fools? They’re just going with the flow…
associated_names: 六零：烧信后，我靠孩子嫁入高门

201089.synopsis:
“What’s for dinner today?”
“…Omurice.”
“Yes! I can’t wait♪”
During summer vacation in his first year of high school, Shirayanagi Minato heads to his part-time housekeeping service job—only to find his mysterious, beautiful classmate, Fujisaki Kanae, waiting for him… along with her disaster of a room!
After getting permission from the flustered Fujisaki-san, Minato thoroughly cleans her room and even prepares dinner for her. He is surprised when Fujisaki-san, who always seemed like a cool lone wolf at school, thanks him so honestly.
